name: Invite People
description: Pasted emails become rows with their own roles. Invalid ones stay flagged, and sending flies each avatar into a pending list while a seat meter fills.

props.name: orgDomain
props.description: Addresses on this domain are the company. Anyone else gets a Guest tag.

props.name: includedSeats
props.description: Seats the plan includes. The meter shows a preview of the valid rows, and invites past this number are marked as over.

props.name: team
props.description: People already in the workspace. They fill the meter and reject duplicate invites.

props.name: pending
props.description: Invites already sent and not yet accepted.

props.name: drafts
props.description: Addresses in the paste well, in order. A missing role uses defaultRole until that row’s menu is used.

props.name: directory
props.description: Known names, so a pasted address can show a person instead of a bare local-part.

props.name: defaultRole
props.description: Role given to a newly typed or pasted address.

props.name: showTeam
props.description: Show the overlapping avatars and names of people already on the team.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Called with the valid rows when Send is pressed. Flagged rows stay in the well. Required to enable the action. Resolve only after acknowledgement; a rejection preserves the draft or pending invitation.

props.name: onWithdraw
props.description: Called when a pending invite is withdrawn and the seat opens again. Required to enable the action. Resolve only after acknowledgement; a rejection preserves the draft or pending invitation.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the Send button and the check on the selected role. Button text flips black or white to stay readable.
